craftersalmanac.config.title: Crafter's Almanac Settings
craftersalmanac.config.show_viewer_butto: Adds a button next to the vanilla recipe book button that shows or hides the almanac. Right-click it to open these settings.
craftersalmanac.config.hide_vanilla_butt: Hides the green recipe book button in the inventory, crafting table and furnaces. The almanac button takes its place.
craftersalmanac.config.show_recipe_ids.t: Shows the recipe's ID (like minecraft:oak_planks) when hovering a recipe's result.
craftersalmanac.config.sort_mode.tooltip: How the sort buttons in your inventory and in chests, barrels and other storage order items. Your hotbar is never moved. Off hides the buttons (handy with another sorting mod).
craftersalmanac.sort.name: Name
While you search, items in the open inventory or chest that don't match fade out, so the matches stand out.
